1417-4279-7192--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-7192--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

401-3944-5332-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-5332-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Repeat.

586-728-4924-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5231-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5231-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

654-1308-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1621-2617-7150.easyPrerequisites: Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
1621-2617-7150.description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Wispweaver Angel's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Wispweaver Angel's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4883-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {4} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4883-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2092-2203-4954.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-2203-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

372-3378-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3378-7487.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

560-2558-5330-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the Soldier enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2438-4460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1169-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1169-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

489-586-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3621-5686-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
3621-5686-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

1306-4300-6871.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3200-3480.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1734-3967-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-3139.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting The Great Henge.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and The Great Henge.
Repeat.

2232-2897-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-2897-6749.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Gigantoplasm enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Gigantoplasm from the battlefield to your hand.
When Gigantoplasm leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Gigantoplasm from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2034-4593-5070.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-5070.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

101-372-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

7-3682-4518-5542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1461-2741-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-2741-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3582-3967.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

240-643-3466-3749.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
240-643-3466-3749.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control by any method.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Reaper King triggers, destroying that creature.
Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until Dread enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
When Dread dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
Resolve Dread's trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Continue from step 3.

662-3628-4836-5159.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Lunar Force to become an artifact until end of turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Lunar Force that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
At the beginning of your end step, Mishra's Warform triggers, causing you to fail to sacrifice Mishra's Warform due to The Master.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, Mishra's Warform triggers, countering that spell and causing you to fail to sacrifice it due to The Master.
Repeat step 4 as necessary.

524-1379-4376.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Because Damping Matrix prevents Aether Storm's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

976-1742-2498.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
976-1742-2498.description:
Activate Greed by paying {B} and two life, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1189-2488.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Apex Altisaur.
1189-2488.description:
Deal damage to Apex Altisaur, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Apex Altisaur is dealt damage by the creature, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Repeat step 2.

411-456-3783-3923-4050.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Manaform Hellkite triggers, creating a 3/3 Dragon Illusion token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, scrying 3 and returning Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon Illusion, adding {U}.
The Dragon Illusion dies, triggering Minn's second ability, putting Grinning Ignus from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

57-1061.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least eight other permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
57-1061.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you do not have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token's ascend ability triggers, causing you to get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3593-5000-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Shivan Phoenix from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Shivan Phoenix, adding {R}.
Shivan Phoenix dies, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

575-1788-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Den Protector, adding {C}{C}.
When Den Protector dies, Yedora triggers, returning Den Protector from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Den Protector by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Den Protector's megamorph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Den Protector triggers, returning any card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-4486-5209.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to increase only Atla Palani's toughness by at least one.
240-4486-5209.description:
Increase Atla's toughness by at least one.
Activate Mirror Entity an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Mirror Entity ability, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 0/0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
All creatures you control except Atla die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Worldspine Wurm died this way, it triggers, shuffling itself into your library.
Atla triggers once for each creature that died.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Atla trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Mirror Entity ability.

971-2034-3048-5003.description:
Sacrifice Roalesk to Ashnod's Altar generating two colorless, with Roalesk's death you proliferate twice, putting two more counters on Pentad Prism.
Remove those counters for two mana, use the other two mana from Ashnod's to return Roalesk to the battlefield using Nim Deathmantle.
Repeat.
